wz.intro: A few quick steps to get going. Everything can be changed later in
wz.pass_note: Set a password to keep strangers out - important on a VPS. Leave blank if this machine is yours alone.
wz.token_ph: Paste the SETUP TOKEN from the server log
wz.tok_a: Javis is running on a public server. To be sure it is really you (not a stranger who stumbled on the link) creating the admin account, you paste a token printed only to the server log - the one place only the machine's owner can read.
wz.tok_how: How to get it (Hostinger → App terminal):
wz.tok_s1: Open the app → click App terminal (this puts you INSIDE the javis container).
wz.tok_s3: Copy the string it prints → paste it into the box above.
wz.tok_ssh: If you SSH into the HOST (not the App terminal):
wz.tok_skip2: if at deploy time you pre-set the env
wz.tok_skip3: (+ JAVIS_ADMIN_USER), the app signs you straight in - no token asked.
wz.prov_note: Pick one main provider. You can change it later in
wz.prov_claude: Sign in with a Claude subscription → full MCP, skills, file read/write, self-improvement loops. The strongest, most complete option.
wz.prov_gpt: Sign in with ChatGPT Plus/Pro (via Codex) → still gets Javis MCP. A good fit if you already pay for ChatGPT.
wz.prov_or: Many cheap models in one place, still with Javis MCP + skills + brain file access. Just an API key - no sign-in.
wz.or_key_later: (you can paste it later in Models)
auth.title: Sign in to Javis
auth.code_hint: Open your Authenticator app and enter the current code. Lost your phone? Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when enabling it.

setm.title: Javis Settings
setm.engine_cli: Claude Code CLI - Javis MCP + skills + loops + shell commands
setm.engine_or: OpenRouter - Javis MCP + skills + loops (no shell commands)
setm.or_note: The model list loads live from OpenRouter. Missing one? Pick "Type another name" and enter its exact id. OpenRouter activates in the next release (P2).
setm.tg_note: Message Javis over Telegram. Uses the engine you picked (the CLI one includes MCP, so you can ask about revenue/ads from your phone). A Morning Briefing bot token works too.
setm.pass_ph: Set a password (leave blank to keep)
setm.auth_note: Set a password to keep strangers out when Javis goes on a VPS. Note: on a VPS, run it behind HTTPS (reverse proxy).
setm.more: Avatar, domain, voice & speed live on the Settings page.

settings.graph_desc: A light canvas graph, no WebGL. Mobile always prefers the light mode.
settings.migrate_desc: Gathers agents, workflows, memory and skills into one flat structure. Only moves things whose target does not exist yet.
settings.c2pa_desc: Images Javis creates carry a provenance mark (Content Credentials) saying they were AI-generated. Facebook reads it to put an "AI-generated" label on posts. Strip the mark and the label usually stops showing, but you remain responsible for disclosing AI content under the law and the platform's terms wherever you post. The javisos.com author label is always kept either way.
settings.c2pa_meta_strip: Provenance is being STRIPPED from newly created images. Images created earlier are unchanged.
settings.c2pa_meta_keep: Default: the provenance mark is kept.
